Slow-tier self-test stages a 16,000-path index with an `ENOBUFS` control. This also retires the dispatch-gates item of the PR A2 bill on #25697.
- Register matchers (`governedSurfacesFor`, `governedPathsIn`, `governedTierFor`, queue guard `codeownersMirrorVerdict`) take an optional register defaulting to `GOVERNED_SURFACES`; no production caller passes one. New battery of 15 cases drives the six nested `ui/` rows through the real matchers (527 assertions, roster floor 35; queue guard 339 cases; prose gate 31 cases).
- PR 2 bill as the thread recorded it (`/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/4b-25712-pr2-bill.md`): six Tier-H rows `ui-adr`, `ui-claude-tree`, `ui-skills-catalog`, `ui-agents-md`, `ui-claude-md`, `ui-workflows` (`repos: ['objectstack']`; `ui/.claude/**` stays Tier H), the AGENTS.md §14 / SKILL.md spans (ratchet ceilings 1117/1117 and 319/319 are freed by PR 2's AGENTS.md rewrite, no ceiling raise), six CODEOWNERS lines, and the pin flip `today-the-register-does-not-know-ui-…`. Cutover window order: subtree PR → PR B → this card's PR 2 → 4a.
- CI on the PR head: all checks green (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core 6/6; UI jobs correctly skipped, no `ui/` tree). `check-governed-merges --pr objectstack-ai/objectstack#25732` on the final file list: NOT governed (0 of 5 paths hit the register), 147 changed lines ≤ 3000 — ordinary queue landing.
- Writes: relay only; no review requested by the thread. CODEOWNERS routes the two enforcement-chain files to the approvers, so leaving draft asks a code owner for review; that is the repository's own rule, not a Tier H ruling.

Landing: the seat flips #25732 ready and arms auto-merge via the relay now. PR 2 is dispatched as its own card thread against this card once the subtree PR window opens.
